newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK PM SIMITIS TO REMOVE GALLSTONE ON SATURDAY.
newsitem.headline: GREEK PM SIMITIS TO REMOVE GALLSTONE ON SATURDAY.

text.p: Greek Prime Minister Costas Simitis will be admitted to hospital on Saturday to remove a gallstone, government officials said on Friday.
The officials said Simitis will undergo a laparotomy at an Athens state hospital and should return home on Sunday.

"It is a simple operation. The laparotomy will take place on Saturday morning and the prime minister should return home on Sunday. He'll stay in bed for a couple of days before resuming his full duties," one government official told Reuters.
Simitis, 60, chaired a cabinet meeting on Friday and looked in good health.
